decisions.reason: SCHEMA.md explicitly requires a justified_by result to depend on its definition through deps. The definition specifies a candidate tensor by its variation identity and asserts uniqueness only conditionally on existence. lem-gr-hilbert-tensor-uniqueness 1.1-4.1 subtracts those identities, realizes every compact test by admitted linear metric families, and uses coefficient vanishing; it never assumes uniqueness. This is the permitted definition-discharge pattern, not a circular proof.

The rejected citation-scope mismatch is real: the inverse-metric/tensor interfaces assume Lorentzian data and the volume interface assumes orientation. The bump-test proof itself uses neither. Replaced those mis-scoped citations by the general covariant tensor transformation law and adjugate formula; defined the local inverse matrix, positive weight and component regularity explicitly. Lowering realizes every bump test and the positive Darboux lower sum forces F=0, with the same covector argument. All original hypotheses and conclusions are retained.

The reverse definition-to-result discharge link is permitted by SCHEMA.md and is not circular. However this particular result establishes conservation equivalence, not well-definedness: the smooth tensor, derivatives and projection are already explicit algebraic/differential constructions from the declared suppliers. Removed the irrelevant justified_by entry, retaining the Definition and its ordinary reference to the conservation proposition exactly. Checked normalization and projection identities and both conservation directions without division by epsilon+p.

Confirmed a nonfatal scope misquotation: the volume-form supplier defines w only in oriented charts. The determinant differentiation, Christoffel cancellation and product-rule proof already establish the stated orientation-free formulas. Defined w locally on every chart, removed the unused oriented-volume dependency, and justified the absolute-Jacobian density law by the general metric transformation and multiplicativity of determinant. No hypothesis, identity or orientation-free conclusion is narrowed.

Both original tuple descriptions inaccurately restated the supplier definitions: dust data are (rho,u) and fluid data are (epsilon,p,n), with T derived. Corrected those two sentences and explicitly gave their derived covariant tensors. The unchanged product-rule proof uses normalization to eliminate longitudinal acceleration, divides only by strictly positive dust rho, and reconstructs fluid divergence from its two projections even when epsilon+p=0. This is a nonfatal interface-description defect, not failure of either equivalence.

Confirmed inconsistent physical units: the item explicitly depends on the SI tensor-slot convention, while T_01=x1 equates energy density with length. Repaired with fixed positive E_* in J/m^3 and L in metres, slab |x1|<L, T_00=3E_* and T_01=E_*x1/L. Every tensor entry now has energy-density units. The original WEC estimate rescales to a strict positive lower bound E_*(v0)^2, and div(T)_0=E_*/L is nonzero with units J/m^4. No observed values or material realization are asserted. Fatal type other records incompatible physical unit premises rather than a failed algebraic inequality.

The rejection conflates an item with its owning page: gr-einstein-and-matter also contains pthm-gr-einstein-consistency-and-energy-conditions, whose Proof 1.1 derives prescribed-T conservation by contracted Bianchi and metric compatibility. There is no missing derivation of stationarity equivalence. Nevertheless the digest identifies a confirmed nonfatal public-scope defect: physical_scope includes prescribed-and-admissible action sectors despite post-gr-classical-gravitational-action (iii) supplying only the scalar action and excluding prescribed dust/fluid from the variational postulate. Removed that incompatible scope branch and replaced the ambiguous on-this-page attribution with the exact sibling item and page IDs. Checked compact localization, linearity in variation jets, both coefficient-vanishing directions and c^3/(16pi G_N)*kappa=1/(2c); the approved equivalence itself is retained.

The cited prop-gr-scalar-field-stress-energy-conservation has kind proposition and domain mathematics, and its conservation identity is a product-rule calculation under explicit geometric hypotheses. Its namespace GR is not a physical classification. Read its identity/proof and the example: equal derivatives fprime in x0,x1 cancel the squared gradient and the wave operator, V=0 gives T=K*dphi tensor dphi, and conservation and positivity follow including all critical points. A read-only prerequisite walk through deps, justified_by and forward_refs found 1833 mathematical carriers, no physical suppliers and no unresolved IDs. The rejection is a false positive; no item edit.

For the additional conclusion below, let $\nabla^\varepsilon$ denote the
metric-selected connection of $g(\varepsilon)$ and assume the Einstein source is an
**independent admissible nonnegative dust input**: for each $\varepsilon$,
there are smooth fields $\mathcal E_\varepsilon:\Omega\to[0,\infty)$ and
$u_\varepsilon$ on $\Omega$, with $u_\varepsilon$ future-directed and
$g(\varepsilon)(u_\varepsilon,u_\varepsilon)=-1$, such that
$T_{ab}=\mathcal E_\varepsilon (u_\varepsilon)_a(u_\varepsilon)_b$ and
$$\nabla^\varepsilon_a(\mathcal E_\varepsilon u_\varepsilon^a)=0,\qquad u_\varepsilon^a\nabla^\varepsilon_a u_\varepsilon^b=0 .$$
Where $\mathcal E_\varepsilon>0$, this is the dust model of
[[def-gr-dust-matter-model]]; where it vanishes, the smooth field
$u_\varepsilon$ remains specified and satisfies the geodesic equation by
the explicit hypotheses above. The stress
conservation identity follows from these equations (and agrees on the
positive-density region with [[prop-gr-dust-and-perfect-fluid-conservation-equations]]).
No comoving condition is imposed: the spatial tilt may be nonzero.
Define the independent rest-mass density
$$\mu_\varepsilon:=\mathcal E_\varepsilon/c^2\quad[\mathrm{kg}\,\mathrm m^{-3}],$$
where $\mathcal E_\varepsilon$ has the rest-energy-density unit
$\mathrm J\,\mathrm m^{-3}$ and $\mu_\varepsilon$ is independent of the
coordinate density $\rho_\varepsilon$.
It factors through $\pi$: normalization gives $\mathcal E_\varepsilon=-g^{ab}T_{ab}=-\kappa^{-1}g^{ab}G_{ab}$, whose components factor through the spatial projection by the Einstein-family hypothesis. Thus $\mu_\varepsilon$ also denotes its resulting smooth spatial function on $U$, including on disconnected fibers.
On $K$, assume the explicit weak-source and tilted slow-motion bounds
$$0\le\mathcal E_\varepsilon\le\frac{C\varepsilon c^4}{G_NL^2},\qquad s_\varepsilon\le C\sqrt\varepsilon\,c,$$
where on the region over $K$ the time orientation is chosen so that
$\partial_0$ is future (and $g(u_\varepsilon,\partial_0)<0$), and
$n_\varepsilon:=\partial_0/\sqrt{-g_{00}}$ is the resulting future unit
coordinate observer, $\gamma_\varepsilon:=-g(u_\varepsilon,n_\varepsilon)$,
$h_{n_\varepsilon}(u_\varepsilon):=u_\varepsilon+g(n_\varepsilon,u_\varepsilon)n_\varepsilon$,
and $s_\varepsilon$ is the norm of
$c\,h_{n_\varepsilon}(u_\varepsilon)/\gamma_\varepsilon$ in the observer's
rest space ([[def-gr-observer-and-rest-space]],
[[lem-gr-observer-relative-velocity-expansions]]). Choose
$$\varepsilon_*'\le\min\{\varepsilon_0,1,(128C)^{-1},(4C^2)^{-1}\},$$
also small enough for the two-jet estimate in the proof. This threshold
condition is dimensionless.
Then, for a constant $C_d$ depending only on $C$, [L7] For a positive-density dust model $T_{ab}=\mathcal E u_a u_b$, $\nabla^aT_{ab}=0$ is equivalent to the dust continuity and geodesic equations; the forward identity $\nabla^aT_{ab}=u_b\nabla_a(\mathcal E u^a)+\mathcal E u^a\nabla_a u_b$ also holds at zero density without division by $\mathcal E$ ([[def-gr-dust-matter-model]], [[prop-gr-dust-and-perfect-fluid-conservation-equations]] clause (a)). The same definition supplies the formal energy-to-mass conversion $\mathcal E_\varepsilon=c^2\mu_\varepsilon$, hence $T_{ab}=c^2\mu_\varepsilon u_a u_b$.
